title: EventsExplanation
description: Wire shape of `explanation` for `bregctl explain events`. `deliveries` is a raw passthrough of the compiled event delivery inventory (`CompiledEventDeliveryInventory`, a `deny_unknown_fields` type shared with package inventories); it is declared opaque in full, because bregctl serializes it directly and its shape can change without any corresponding line changing in bregctl.

deliveries.description: Passthrough of the compiled event delivery inventory. Shape follows CompiledEventDelivery and is outside this contract version.
